title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: splicelogic R/Bioconductor package detecting alternative splicing events exon-level data stored GRanges objects. Given set exons annotated coefficient column indicating differential transcript usage (DTU), splicelogic identifies following types splicing events: Skipped exons (SE) – exons present one isoform absent another. Mutually exclusive exons (MXE) – pairs exons one included expense . Retained introns (RI) – intronic regions retained part exon alternative isoform. Alternative 5’ (A5SS) – exons share 3’ splice site differ 5’ end. Alternative 3’ (A3SS) – exons share 5’ splice site differ 3’ end.

title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: DTU results attached GRanges exons significant transcripts, one can use following code identify splice events:
code: exons <- preprocess_input(exons, coef_col = "coefs") skipped <- exons |> calc_skipped_exons() mut_exc <- exons |> calc_mx_exons() # etc.

title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: splicelogic assumes user run kind DTU (e.g. isoform switching) statistical analysis providing error bound (FDR) effect estimate (e.g. model coefficient deltaPSI) (see upstream methods). also assumes user can obtain ranges representing exon structure transcript analyzed (see obtaining exon ranges. exons flat GRanges object (one range per exon), containing exon-level metadata gene ID, transcript ID, rank transcript. Information DTU analysis also present metadata. Code demonstrates generating GTF file attaching metdata DTU results table. coefficient input coef_col indicates differential transcript usage (DTU) specific transcript containing exon. exons transcript share coefficient value. values comes prior differential transcript usage analysis, performed satuRn. Positive coefficient values indicate upregulated exons negative values indicate downregulated exons.

text: prepare_exons() extracts exon ranges TxDb object merges DTU results table single call. returns flat GRanges ready preprocess_input(). step--step breakdown prepare_exons() internally, see Obtaining exon ranges manually.
code: library(AnnotationHub) ah <- AnnotationHub() txdb <- ah[["AH75191"]] # extract transcript table as tibble txps <- txdb |>   AnnotationDbi::select(keys(txdb, "TXID"), c("TXNAME","GENEID"), "TXID") |>   tibble::as_tibble() |>   dplyr::select(tx_num = TXID, tx_id = TXNAME, gene_id = GENEID) # simulate DTU results dtu_table <- txps |>   dplyr::mutate(     padj = runif(dplyr::n()),     effect_est = rnorm(dplyr::n())   )  exons <- prepare_exons(txdb, dtu_table, coef_col = "effect_est", verbose = TRUE) gr <- preprocess_input(exons, coef_col = "effect_est")

title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: calc_skipped_exons() identifies exons present downregulated transcripts absent (skipped) upregulated ones. Using gr object generated create_mock_data(), can generate skiped exon events generate_skipped_exons() function, modifies input GRanges object include skipped exon events. can run detection function calc_skipped_exons() modified GRanges object: result GRanges object containing exons flagged skipped, event column set "skipped_exon". "tx_id" refers transcript includes skipped exon, "tx_event" indicates transcripts respect exon skipped (.e. downregulated transcripts include exon).
code: gr_se <- generate_skipped_exons(gr, n_se = 2) gr_se <- preprocess_input(gr_se, coef_col = "coefs") se_result <- calc_skipped_exons(gr_se) se_result mcols(se_result)[, c("gene_id", "tx_id", "n_txp", "event", "tx_event")]

title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: section walks steps prepare_exons() performs internally. useful need control process want understand exon ranges built TxDb. following extracts exons TxDb: build transcript table, likely already provided upstream DTU method. Suppose already DTU results transcripts: Next flattening exons: Adding DTU results gene ID:
code: # first we get an example TxDB for our exon ranges suppressPackageStartupMessages({   library(AnnotationHub)   library(GenomicFeatures)   library(tibble) }) # here we will use the transcript database for GENCODE v32 from AHub # typically, you should supply your own GTF to makeTxDbFromGFF() ah <- AnnotationHub() txdb <- ah[["AH75191"]] # extract exons as a GRangesList ebt <- GenomicFeatures::exonsBy(txdb, by="tx") # exon id, name, and rank # extract transcript table as tibble txps <- txdb |>   AnnotationDbi::select(keys(txdb, "TXID"), c("TXNAME","GENEID"), "TXID") |>   tibble::as_tibble() |>   dplyr::select(tx_num = TXID, tx_id = TXNAME, gene_id = GENEID) # here just simulated results dtu_table <- txps |>   dplyr::mutate(     padj = runif(dplyr::n()),     effect_est = rnorm(dplyr::n())   ) # check the concordance... all.equal(dtu_table$tx_num, as.integer(names(ebt))) # and if aligned, set new names for exons exons <- ebt names(exons) <- dtu_table$tx_id exons <- unlist(exons) exons$tx_id <- names(exons) names(exons) <- exons$exon_name # arrange `dtu_table` as in `exons`, including duplicates txp_idx <- match(exons$tx_id, dtu_table$tx_id) add_columns <- dtu_table[txp_idx,] |>   dplyr::select(-c(tx_id, tx_num)) merged_DF <- cbind(mcols(exons), add_columns) mcols(exons) <- merged_DF

title: Calculate splice events from a GRanges object — calc_events
text: gr GRanges object exon annotations, including 'tx_id', 'exon', 'coef_col' metadata columns preprocessed preprocess_input(). type type overlap consider identifying events. inverse TRUE, identifies included exons instead skipped exons. by_start TRUE, detects a5ss (exon start, different end). FALSE, detects a3ss (end, different start). verbose TRUE, prints progress messages. Default TRUE.

title: Calculate splice events from a GRanges object — calc_events
text: calc_skipped_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating skipped exons. calc_included_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating included exons. calc_mx_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating mutually exclusive exons. calc_retained_introns(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating retained introns. calc_alt_ss(): GRanges object annotated events alternative splice sites. calc_a5ss(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating a5ss events. calc_a3ss(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating a3ss events. calc_all_events(): GRanges object combining detected events, 'event' metadata column indicating event type.
